data.title: Ether.fi Mandates Optimum’s mump2p for All Its Node Operators
data.description: The MIT-born startup says 16 node operators now run its mump2p software on Ethereum mainnet for more than 1.4 million ETH in stake, and that blocks arrive faster than over Ethereum's default gossip layer.
